brain.quote: I think there are some who will just, like, present crap and it'll perform well. But yes, as a general view, the integration should be hidden as much as possible, at least at the start of the integration. That means the logo doesn't come in during the first 15-20 seconds of the integration. And yes, everyone should have that same pattern of a smooth transition, like what we constantly, constantly insist on for every client.
brain.body_head:
